newsitem.title: USA: PhyMatrix, NYC's Beth Israel team up.
newsitem.headline: PhyMatrix, NYC's Beth Israel team up.

text.p: PhyMatrix Corp said Tuesday that it and Beth Israel Medical Center, which is a unit of Greater Metropolitan Health Systems, have signed a letter of intent to form an organization to provide management services to the medical community in the greater New York metropolitan area.
The proposed agreement provides for PhyMatrix to acquire the physician practice management operations of Beth Israel, U.S. Management Systems.

U.S. Management currently serves several hundred physicians and manages the DOCS network, consisting of 130 physicians with more than 20 primary and specialty medical offices located throughout New York City and Rockland and Westchester counties.
DOCS will remain wholly owned by Beth Israel.

The letter of intent contemplates that the management services organization will be owned jointly by PhyMatrix and Beth Israel and provide practice management services and negotiate and manage risk contracting for physicians.
